nodes.speaker: Dungeon Door
nodes.text: The ancient door stands open. A cold wind rises from the darkness below, carrying the smell of damp stone and something else -- something old.

nodes.speaker: Dungeon Door
nodes.text: You steel yourself and step through the doorway. Stone stairs spiral downward into the dark...

actions.value: You descend into the dungeon beneath the cellar.

nodes.speaker: Dungeon Door
nodes.text: You step back from the threshold. The darkness below can wait -- for now.

nodes.speaker: Dungeon Door
nodes.text: Hidden behind the remains of the rat nests, a heavy stone door is set into the cellar wall. Strange markings are carved around the frame -- old writing, long faded. Cold air seeps through the cracks. The door is sealed tight.

nodes.speaker: Dungeon Door
nodes.text: The carvings are a warning, written in an old tongue. You cannot read them, but the meaning is clear enough -- whatever is behind this door was meant to stay there. The Sage might know more.

actions.value: You found a sealed door behind the rat nests. The Sage should know about this.

nodes.speaker: Dungeon Door
nodes.text: A heavy stone door, firmly sealed. You see no way to open it.
